response.original_title: Can I add a person to my Princess Cruise?
response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a person to an Princess Cruise booking, but you cannot do it online or through the mobile app. Contact Princess directly +1-866-829-1280(US) or reach out to your travel agent to process the change manually. Provide your booking number along with the new guest's full name, date of birth, +1-866-829-1280(US) and travel document information. Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can add a person to an existing Princess Cruise booking by calling Princess Customer Service +1-866-829-1280(US) or contacting your travel agent, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app.
